description: Get detailed information for a specific GDACS disaster event by ID. Returns event name, alert level with justification, affected population at each severity level, coordinates, geometry for mapping, source agency, and situation report links.

event_type.description: Event type code: EQ=earthquake, TC=tropical cyclone, FL=flood, VO=volcano, DR=drought, TS=tsunami

name: gdacs.disasters.details

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.
